summary: ArrayList is Java's resizable list. Use it instead of an array when the number of items changes while the program runs.
notes: import java.util.ArrayList is required at the top of the file.
add(item) adds to the end. add(0, item) adds at the front and shifts the rest right.
Use size() for an ArrayList. Arrays use .length and Strings use length().
pitfall: playlist.get(4) on a list of size 4 throws IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 4 out of bounds for length 4. The last index is size() - 1.
